SpecialAction.Name: Request Early KC-46A Pegasus Tanker Delivery
SpecialAction.ScriptText:
local PegasusDeliveryChance if UseRealisticVariables() then if ScenarioYear() == 'early2020' then PegasusDeliveryChance = 40 else PegasusDeliveryChance = 60 end else if UseRandomVariables() then PegasusDeliveryChance = GetRandomRoundedNumber(0, 100, 5) else PegasusDeliveryChance = 100 end end if math.random(1,100) <= PegasusDeliveryChance then local PlayerSide = ScenEdit_PlayerSide() AddAircraft(PlayerSide, 11, 14, 5514, '120 Sqd.', 'Nevatim AB', 18313, 0) TelexMessageToPlayer( 'IMMEDIATE', -- Precedence nil, -- Time 'O', -- Code 'MINISTRY OF DEFENSE', -- Sender 'GENERAL HQ
AIR OPERATIONS CENTER//CC//', -- Recipient 'TOP SECRET', -- Classification 'REQUEST FOR US MISSILE STRIKES', -- Subject 'THE UNITED STATES HAS AGREED TO IMMEDIATELY DELIVER FOUR KC-46 PEGASUS TANKERS. THEY HAVE BEEN ASSIGNED TO 120 SQUADRON AT NEVATIM AIR BASE.', -- Body nil -- location ) else TelexMessageToPlayer( 'IMMEDIATE', -- Precedence nil, -- Time 'O', -- Code 'MINISTRY OF DEFENSE', -- Sender 'GENERAL HQ
AIR OPERATIONS CENTER//CC//', -- Recipient 'TOP SECRET', -- Classification 'REQUEST FOR US MISSILE STRIKES', -- Subject 'THE UNITED STATES HAS DENIED OUR REQUEST TO IMMEDIATELY DELIVER FOUR KC-46 PEGASUS TANKERS.', -- Body nil -- location ) end

SpecialAction.Name: Request US Missile Strikes
SpecialAction.ScriptText:
local MissileSupportChance if UseRealisticVariables() then if ScenarioYear() == 'early2020' then MissileSupportChance = 60 else MissileSupportChance = 80 end else if UseRandomVariables() then MissileSupportChance = GetRandomRoundedNumber(0, 100, 5) else MissileSupportChance = 100 end end if math.random(1,100) <= MissileSupportChance then local missionRefPoints, mission_1, mission_2, messageString if ScenarioYear() == 'early2020' or ScenarioYear() == 'mid2020' then missionRefPoints = { {name='SSN Patrol-01', latitude=24.5, longitude=58.5}, {name='SSN Patrol-02', latitude=24.5, longitude=59}, {name='SSN Patrol-03', latitude=24, longitude=59}, {name='SSN Patrol-04', latitude=24, longitude=58.5}, {name='SSGN Patrol-01', latitude=24, longitude=59.5}, {name='SSGN Patrol-02', latitude=24, longitude=60}, {name='SSGN Patrol-03', latitude=23.5, longitude=60}, {name='SSGN Patrol-04', latitude=23.5, longitude=59.5}, } for _, refPoint in ipairs(missionRefPoints) do ScenEdit_AddReferencePoint({side='Israel', name=refPoint.name, latitude=refPoint.latitude, longitude=refPoint.longitude}) end mission_1 = ScenEdit_AddMission('Israel', 'SSN Patrol', 'Patrol', {type='naval', zone={'SSN Patrol-01', 'SSN Patrol-02','SSN Patrol-03', 'SSN Patrol-04'}}) mission_2 = ScenEdit_AddMission('Israel', 'SSGN Patrol', 'Patrol', {type='naval', zone={'SSGN Patrol-01', 'SSGN Patrol-02','SSGN Patrol-03', 'SSGN Patrol-04'}}) ScenEdit_SetMission('Israel', mission_1.guid, {LoopType=1, TransitDepthSubmarinePreset='shallow', StationThrottleSubmarine='creep', StationDepthSubmarinePreset='shallow', AttackThrottleSubmarine='creep', AttackDepthSubmarinePreset='shallow'}) ScenEdit_SetMission('Israel', mission_2.guid, {LoopType=1, TransitDepthSubmarinePreset='shallow', StationThrottleSubmarine='creep', StationDepthSubmarinePreset='shallow', AttackThrottleSubmarine='creep', AttackDepthSubmarinePreset='shallow'}) local submarine_1 = ScenEdit_AddUnit({side='Israel', type='Submarine', dbid=675, name='USS Vermont (SSN-792)', latitude=24, longitude=58.5, heading=0, speed=5, altitude=-39.9288}) local submarine_2 = ScenEdit_AddUnit({side='Israel', type='Submarine', dbid=565, name='USS Georgia (SSGN-729)', latitude=23.5, longitude=59.5, heading=0, speed=5, altitude=-39.9288}) local ssn = ScenEdit_GetUnit({guid=submarine_1.guid}) for _, magazine in ipairs(ssn.magazines) do if magazine.mag_dbid == 1976 then ScenEdit_AddWeaponToUnitMagazine({guid=ssn.guid, mag_guid=magazine.mag_guid, wpn_dbid=4033, number=8, remove=true}) end end ScenEdit_AddReloadsToUnit({guid=submarine_2.guid, wpn_dbid=4033, number=98, remove=true}) ScenEdit_AssignUnitToMission(submarine_1.guid, 'SSN Patrol') ScenEdit_AssignUnitToMission(submarine_2.guid, 'SSGN Patrol') messageString = 'THE UNITED STATES HAS ASSIGNED THE USS GEORGIA (SSGN 729) AND USS VERMONT (SSN 794) IN THE ARABIAN SEA TO SUPPORT OUR STRIKES. WE ARE NOT AUTHORIZED TO REPOSITION THEM. THEY MUST REMAIN WITHIN 10 NAUTICAL MILES OF THEIR PATROL AREAS. THEY HAVE ALLOCATED US FIFTY SIX TOMAHAWK MISSILES ON THE USS GEORGIA AND TWELVE FROM THE USS VERMONT.' else missionRefPoints = { {name='SSGN Patrol-01', latitude=24, longitude=59.5}, {name='SSGN Patrol-02', latitude=24, longitude=60}, {name='SSGN Patrol-03', latitude=23.5, longitude=60}, {name='SSGN Patrol-04', latitude=23.5, longitude=59.5}, {name='DDG Patrol-01', latitude=23.5, longitude=61}, {name='DDG Patrol-02', latitude=23.5, longitude=61.5}, {name='DDG Patrol-03', latitude=23, longitude=61.5}, {name='DDG Patrol-04', latitude=23, longitude=61}, } for _, refPoint in ipairs(missionRefPoints) do ScenEdit_AddReferencePoint({side='Israel', name=refPoint.name, latitude=refPoint.latitude, longitude=refPoint.longitude}) end mission_1 = ScenEdit_AddMission('Israel', 'SSGN Patrol', 'Patrol', {type='naval', zone={'SSGN Patrol-01', 'SSGN Patrol-02','SSGN Patrol-03', 'SSGN Patrol-04'}}) mission_2 = ScenEdit_AddMission('Israel', 'DDG Patrol', 'Patrol', {type='naval', zone={'DDG Patrol-01', 'DDG Patrol-02','DDG Patrol-03', 'DDG Patrol-04'}}) ScenEdit_SetMission('Israel', mission_1.guid, {LoopType=1, TransitDepthSubmarinePreset='shallow', StationThrottleSubmarine='creep', StationDepthSubmarinePreset='shallow', AttackThrottleSubmarine='creep', AttackDepthSubmarinePreset='shallow'}) ScenEdit_SetMission('Israel', mission_2.guid, {LoopType=1, TransitThrottleShip='cruise', StationThrottleShip='cruise', AttackThrottleShip='cruise'}) local submarine_1 = ScenEdit_AddUnit({side='Israel', type='Submarine', dbid=668, name='USS Arizona (SSN-803)', latitude=23.5, longitude=59.5, heading=0, speed=5, altitude=-39.9288}) local ship_1 = ScenEdit_AddUnit({side='Israel', type='ship', dbid=3343, name='USS Zumwalt (DDG-1000)', latitude=23, longitude=61, heading=0, speed=20}) local ssgn = ScenEdit_GetUnit({guid=submarine_1.guid}) for _, magazine in ipairs(ssgn.magazines) do if magazine.mag_dbid == 1993 then ScenEdit_AddWeaponToUnitMagazine({guid=ssgn.guid, mag_guid=magazine.mag_guid, wpn_dbid=4071, number=8, remove=true}) end end for _, mount in ipairs(ssgn.mounts) do if mount.mount_dbid == 2527 then ScenEdit_AddReloadsToUnit({guid=ssgn.guid, wpn_dbid=4071, number=28, remove=true}) ScenEdit_AddReloadsToUnit({guid=ssgn.guid, wpn_dbid=4394, number=12}) end end ScenEdit_AssignUnitToMission(submarine_1.guid, 'SSGN Patrol') ScenEdit_AssignUnitToMission(ship_1.guid, 'DDG Patrol') messageString = 'THE UNITED STATES HAS ASSIGNED THE USS Zumwalt (DDG 1000) AND USS ARIZONA (SSN 803) IN THE ARABIAN SEA TO SUPPORT OUR STRIKES. WE ARE NOT AUTHORIZED TO REPOSITION THEM. THEY MUST REMAIN WITHIN 10 NAUTICAL MILES OF THEIR PATROL AREAS. THEY HAVE ALLOCATED US FIFTY SIX TOMAHAWK AND TWELVE LONG-RANGE HYPERSONIC (LRHW) MISSILES ON THE USS ZUMWALT AND TWELVE TOMAHAWKS AND LRHWS FROM THE USS ARIZONA.' end ScenEdit_SetEvent('Check If USN Ships Are In Patrol Areas', {isActive=true}) TelexMessageToPlayer( 'IMMEDIATE', -- Precedence nil, -- Time 'O', -- Code 'MINISTRY OF DEFENSE', -- Sender 'GENERAL HQ
AIR OPERATIONS CENTER//CC//', -- Recipient 'TOP SECRET', -- Classification 'REQUEST FOR US MISSILE STRIKES', -- Subject messageString, -- Body nil -- location ) else TelexMessageToPlayer( 'IMMEDIATE', -- Precedence nil, -- Time 'O', -- Code 'MINISTRY OF DEFENSE', -- Sender 'GENERAL HQ
AIR OPERATIONS CENTER//CC//', -- Recipient 'TOP SECRET', -- Classification 'REQUEST FOR US MISSILE STRIKES', -- Subject 'THE UNITED STATES HAS DENIED OUR REQUEST TO PARTICIPATE IN OUR STRIKES ON IRAN.', -- Body nil -- location ) end

SpecialAction.Name: Request US Tanker Support
SpecialAction.ScriptText:
local TankerSupportChance if UseRealisticVariables() then if ScenarioYear() == 'early2020' TankerSupportChance = 70 else TankerSupportChance = 90 end else if UseRandomVariables() then TankerSupportChance = GetRandomRoundedNumber(0, 100, 5) else TankerSupportChance = 100 end end if math.random(1,100) <= TankerSupportChance then local TankerDBID, TankerCallsign, TankerLoadoutID, TankerBase, NumTankerString, TankerString, BaseString, CountryString if ScenarioYear() == 'early2020' then TankerDBID = 214 -- KC-10A Extender, 1982 TankerCallsign = 'TEXACO' TankerLoadoutID = 8989 TankerBase = 'Al Dhafra AB' TankerString = 'KC-10 EXTENDERS' BaseString = 'AL DHAFRA AIR BASE' CountryString = 'THE UNITED ARAB EMIRATES' else TankerDBID = 214 -- KC-135R Stratotankers, 2020 TankerCallsign = 'SHELL' TankerLoadoutID = 32850 TankerBase = 'Al Udeid AB' TankerString = 'KC-135 STRATOTANKERS' BaseString = 'AL UDEID AIR BASE' CountryString = 'QATAR' end AddAircraft('Israel', 11, 18, TankerDBID, TankerCallsign..' ', TankerBase, TankerLoadoutID, 0) TelexMessageToPlayer( 'IMMEDIATE', -- Precedence nil, -- Time 'O', -- Code 'MINISTRY OF DEFENSE', -- Sender 'GENERAL HQ
AIR OPERATIONS CENTER//CC//', -- Recipient 'TOP SECRET', -- Classification 'REQUEST FOR US TANKER SUPPORT', -- Subject 'THE UNITED STATES HAS AGREED TO PROVIDE REFUELING SUPPORT. EIGHT '..TankerString..' AT '..BaseString..' IN '..CountryString..' HAVE BEEN MADE AVAILABLE TO SUPPORT OUR OPERATION.', -- Body nil -- location ) else TelexMessageToPlayer( 'IMMEDIATE', -- Precedence nil, -- Time 'O', -- Code 'MINISTRY OF DEFENSE', -- Sender 'GENERAL HQ
AIR OPERATIONS CENTER//CC//', -- Recipient 'TOP SECRET', -- Classification 'REQUEST FOR US MISSILE STRIKES', -- Subject 'THE UNITED STATES HAS DENIED TO OUR REQUEST FOR REFUELING SUPPORT.', -- Body nil -- location ) end
